summary: Frontend-only verification of (1) global CommandPalette and (2) Avatar upload flow in Account Settings modal. All 15+ checks passed. Palette opens via '/' and Ctrl/Cmd+K on /dashboard, /apps, and homepage; input-focus guard works on dashboard inputs and workspace chat textarea; ArrowUp/Down + Enter navigates; Esc + backdrop close. Avatar upload downscales to data URL, PATCHes /api/auth/profile, updates settings-avatar-img, account-menu-btn (D→img), and menu panel; persists across reload via /api/auth/me; settings-avatar-remove clears it with 'Picture removed' toast. User state restored (no avatar, name 'Doc Tester').

issues: React hydration warning: <span> inside <option> in NativeApps.jsx (~line 269). Pre-existing, not related to this iteration. Recommend wrapping option label as plain text instead of span.

critical_code_review_comments: CommandPalette input-focus guard correctly checks INPUT/TEXTAREA/SELECT tags and isContentEditable — solid.
AccountSettingsModal.onAvatarFile validates image mime and downscales to 160px JPEG canvas — good client-side compression.
Minor: 'Profile picture updated' toast disappeared before assertion (timing); functional behavior confirmed via /me and DOM. Consider extending toast duration if UX tests need to catch it.
Pre-existing warning: NativeApps hydration warning in console — should be plain text.
seed_data_creation: None. Uploaded a 16x16 PNG, then removed. Final user state: avatar=None, name='Doc Tester'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Note: on /dashboard the sub-header does NOT contain account-menu-btn (that lives in the site header on / and /apps). To open Account Settings modal reliably, navigate to homepage or /apps first. The settings-avatar-file input is intentionally hidden (class='hidden'); use set_input_files without waiting for visibility. Test PNG bytes: any small image works, output is always JPEG data URL after canvas downscale.
